stem:
Fraction strips are shown.

Which comparison and explanation are true?

options.label: A
options.text: \( \frac{5}{6} < \frac{5}{8} \), because eighths are larger than sixths

options.label: B
options.text: \( \frac{5}{6} < \frac{5}{8} \), because sixths are larger than eighths

options.label: C
options.text: \( \frac{5}{6} > \frac{5}{8} \), because eighths are larger than sixths

options.label: D
options.text: \( \frac{5}{6} > \frac{5}{8} \), because sixths are larger than eighths

visual_elements: Two fraction strips are shown. The top strip is divided into 6 equal parts. The bottom strip is divided into 8 equal parts.
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding of fraction sizes relative to denominators and comparing two fractions with different denominators using visual aids.
